description: Place a new buy order for ENERGY or BANDWIDTH on TronSave, paid from the internal account balance. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Side effect: SPENDS internal TRX balance and creates a live order; not idempotent — each call places a new order. This is the api-key/internal path; for the signature-session market path use `tronsave_create_order`. Always derive `unitPrice` from the latest `tronsave_internal_order_estimate` (re-estimate immediately before submitting — quotes older than a few seconds may be stale and revert). Returns `{ orderId }`.

durationSec.description: Delegation duration in seconds. Default 259200 (3 days) when omitted.

options.description: Optional execution guards and fill behavior.

allowPartialFill.description: Allow partial fill. Default true when omitted.

maxPriceAccepted.description: Maximum unit price in SUN you accept.

minResourceDelegateRequiredAmount.description: Minimum resource amount per matching provider (resource units).

onlyCreateWhenFulfilled.description: Only create if the order can be 100% fulfilled. Default false when omitted.

preventDuplicateIncompleteOrders.description: Skip if an identical pending order already exists. Default false when omitted.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address that will receive the resource.

resourceAmount.description: Amount of resource to purchase (resource units).

resourceType.description: Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted.

unitPrice.description: Pricing: FAST | MEDIUM | SLOW strategy, or exact unit price in SUN per resource unit. Default MEDIUM when omitted.

name: tronsave_internal_order_create
title: Create Energy or Bandwidth Order (Internal)
